feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 July 2026 10:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 22 July 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North or northwest, 4 or 5 in most waters, but occasionally increasing 6 in the west of the area and around the Isle of Man at first tonight. Then decreasing variable 2 or 3 by tomorrow afternoon in the southwest of the area towards Dublin Bay, before becoming 3 or 4 in most waters later Thursday evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 3 or 4, backing west or southwest overnight into Friday, occasionally increasing 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
